content: Analysis. To better understand our model, we analyze the accuracy of the classifier in our joint model. We obtain 75.3 classification accuracy on the development with the threshold 0.5. By increasing value of INLINEFORM0 in Eq EQREF9 , the classification accuracy reached to 76.8 ( INLINEFORM1 ), however the final results of our model only have a small improvement (+0.2 in terms of F1 score). It shows that it is important to make balance between these two components: the span detector and unanswerable classifier.
